viewingMethod: desktop/mobile/landscape 4-second corrected full scenes viewed directly
tall 4-second corrected full scene viewed through two unscaled native bands spanning y0..2050
Each corrected skyline atlas viewed completely as 9 unscaled full-width rows in requested time order (36 rows total)

Additional unscaled 24-native-pixel context crops for every calculated visible star/window position copied from the same corrected atlases into temporary 9-column matrices; all four matrices actually viewed. No new original artwork or resampling.
findings: All four compositions retain coherent night palette, building silhouettes, window frames, rooftop support, cats, trains and aircraft; no new bright rectangles, broken outlines or visible pixel displacement.

Selected star cores vary in intensity across samples and retain their small light points when dim. Different stars have different observed brightness combinations, while clouds and passing aircraft can obscure particular cores.

Selected distant window cores show lit/dim/off differences in separate parts of buildings across sampled times, without a uniform whole-building flash. Neighboring facades and lit background windows remain intact.
Changes occupy very small distant cores; screenshots demonstrate temporal differences but do not establish that every viewer will notice them without looking toward the skyline.
limitations: Nine finite requested times 0/2/4/6/8/18/22/26/30 do not prove all future events unique or statistically random; nonperiodic timing properties are assessed separately by source/unit checks.
Geometry, alpha and eligibility fields in capture.json are calculated expectations, not pixel timing measurements; the final rendered 20fps frame may precede each requested time.
Some cores can be occluded by clouds/aircraft. Crops near a viewport edge can contain empty padding in temporary matrices; original full-width corrected images were checked separately.
No continuous video or subjective smoothness measurement was performed.
parentChecksReportedSeparately: Parent reports actual pixel RGB-range measurements in core-sample-measurements.json and additional temporary 2-star/2-window crops per device. Those numeric checks were performed by parent, not this reviewer; this decision relies on this reviewer’s own complete corrected-image views.
